feature: FSL FLIRT scaled-mm to world-RAS conversion

contract.fsl_flirt_matrix: moving/input to fixed/reference in FSL scaled-mm coordinates
contract.package_forward: moving to fixed in world-RAS coordinates
contract.package_pull: fixed to moving in world-RAS coordinates

fsl_img2imgcoord.note: The FSL command prints limited decimal precision.

interpretation: The converter reproduces FSL's coordinate mapping after the scaled-mm basis and direction are handled explicitly. Scalar comparison used a common fixed grid. FNIRT fields were not reinterpreted as SynthMorph RAS pull fields.
privacy: Aggregate-only; source paths, subject identifiers, matrices, and point coordinates are excluded.
